changelog: Say "read back" — in English or Bengali ("পড়ে শোনাও") — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the keyboard reads aloud what it dictated in the current message, so a misheard word is caught hands-free before sending instead of after. Gboard has no such read-back. The mic pauses while it reads, then listening resumes, or tap the mic to stop the reading. It only ever reads what the keyboard itself dictated — text typed before dictating is never read. Saying the phrase inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text.
